RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:INV-004.statement: Every response carries Content-Type application/json, except the 204 of DELETE /bookings/:bookingId, which carries no body and no Content-Type; tests/errors/errors.test.ts:91-100: marked test checks serializability and status but never checks an HTTP header or a 204 response
RV-002 [implementer] room-booking-api:INV-003.statement: a room_busy body also carries conflictingBookingId; src/errors/index.ts:45-46: apiError accepts room_busy and returns a body with only error

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:INV-005.test_obligation: a restarted process starts with an empty store; tests/state/state.test.ts:5: resetModules reimports in the same process rather than stopping and restarting it
RV-002 [implementer] room-booking-api:INV-002.statement: two intervals overlap exactly when a is before d and c is before b; src/state/index.ts:44: Date.UTC remaps years 0 through 99 and the subsequent year check rejects them

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:CTR-004.compatibility_rules: a supplied body that is not valid JSON yields 400 invalid_json before any endpoint rule; tests/bookings/read/read.test.ts:191-207: the contract test calls listBookings directly and never sends a request body

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:CTR-001.error_taxonomy: E_INVALID_JSON 400 invalid_json; room-booking-api:CTR-002.compatibility_rules: a supplied body that is not valid JSON yields 400 invalid_json; room-booking-api:BEH-001.then: status 201, Content-Type application/json; tests/rooms/rooms.test.ts:13-28,134-159,222-235: direct module calls only, with no HTTP, malformed-body, success status or header assertions

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:CTR-005.schema.success: 'status: 204, body: none, no Content-Type header'; tests/bookings/write/booking-write.test.ts:265-275,296-306: tests call deleteBooking directly and assert deleted: true, not the HTTP status, body or headers
RV-002 [test-writer] room-booking-api:BEH-008.negative_cases: 'body that is not valid JSON => 400 invalid_json, not 404 room_not_found'; tests/bookings/write/booking-write.test.ts:137-149,296-306: parsed values and booking ids are passed directly to module functions, with no malformed HTTP body or parsing precedence assertion

payload.detail: tests/bookings/write/booking-write.test.ts:505-512 (names b1 when two conflicting bookings on different days both overlap) posts start 2026-11-02T09:15:00Z, end 2026-11-03T09:15:00Z, a 24-hour interval, and expects 409 room_busy with conflictingBookingId b1. CTR-003 duration_limit and BEH-009 say a duration longer than 8 hours yields 400 invalid_booking, and createBooking decides invalid_booking before room_busy. The test asserts room_busy where the record requires invalid_booking. The other 122 tests pass and tsc exits 0.
